messages.subject: Meeting Wednesday + Tea Time Thursday
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We'll be meeting from 10-noon virtually this week (link below). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. The DataLab is also hosting Summer Tea Time this Thursday at 1pm in the DataLab Classroom (Library 360). There will be socializing from 1-2pm and independent work from 2-4pm. Hot drinks and cookies will be provided!

Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: Permanent Tea Time and Co-Working are here!
messages.subject_clean: Permanent Tea Time and Co-Working are here!
messages.body_plain:
Hi Everyone!

The DataLab has made Tea Time and DataLab Co-Working a permanent (as much as anything is) part of our activities. They are even still at the same place and time! If you forgot though they are in the same place as D-RUG (DataLab Classroom, Library 360). Tea Time runs from 1-2pm and Co-Working runs from 2-4pm. The official blurbs and calendar links are below:

Take a break from your work physically and mentally with Tea Time at the DataLab. Join us for tea (or coffee) and cookies. Connect and socialize with other people in the data science community. We will meet every Thursday during the Fall Quarter from 1-2pm in the DataLab Classroom (Library 360 <https://library.ucdavis.edu/floor-maps/?floor=3>). This is not Office Hours or a place to get help, but rather a way to take a break from whatever problem you are working on.
+ Google Calendar <https://www.google.com/calendar/event?action=TEMPLATE&dates=20240926T130000/20240926T140000&text=Tea%20Time&details=Take+a+break+from+your+work+physically+and+mentally+with+Tea+Time+at+the+DataLab.+Join+us+for+tea+%28or+coffee%29+and+cookies.+Connect+and+socialize+with+other+people+in+the+data+science+community.+We+will+meet+every+Thursday+during+the+Fall+Quarter+from+1-2pm+in+the+DataLab+Classroom+%28%3Ca+href%3D%22https%3A%2F%2Flibrary.ucdavis.edu%2Ffloor-maps%2F%3Ffloor%3D3%22+rel%3D%22nofollow%22%3ELibrary+360%3C%2Fa%3E%29.+This+is+not+Office+Hours+or+a+place+to+get+help%2C+but+rather+a+way+to+take+a+break+from+whatever+problem+you+are+working+on.&location=DataLab%20Classroom%20–%20Shields%20360,%20Shields%20Library,%203rd%20floor,%20100%20NW%20Quad,%20Davis,%20CA,%2095616,%20United%20States&trp=false&ctz=America/Los_Angeles&sprop=website:https://datalab.ucdavis.edu>+ Add to iCalendar <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/tea-time/?ical=1>

Miss human interaction but still need to get work done? Hit a road block and need a change of scenery to change your thought processes. Shake up your normal work schedule with Co-Working at the DataLab! We will meet every Thursday during the Fall Quarter from 2-4pm in the DataLab Classroom (Library 360 <https://library.ucdavis.edu/floor-maps/?floor=3>). This is not Office Hours or a place to get help, but rather a way to be in community with others while still getting work done.
+ Google Calendar <https://www.google.com/calendar/event?action=TEMPLATE&dates=20240926T140000/20240926T160000&text=DataLab%20Co-Working&details=Miss+human+interaction+but+still+need+to+get+work+done%3F+Hit+a+road+block+and+need+a+change+of+scenery+to+change+your+thought+processes.+Shake+up+your+normal+work+schedule+with+Co-Working+at+the+DataLab%21+We+will+meet+every+Thursday+during+the+Fall+Quarter+from+2-4pm+in+the+DataLab+Classroom+%28%3Ca+href%3D%22https%3A%2F%2Flibrary.ucdavis.edu%2Ffloor-maps%2F%3Ffloor%3D3%22+rel%3D%22nofollow%22%3ELibrary+360%3C%2Fa%3E%29.+This+is+not+Office+Hours+or+a+place+to+get+help%2C+but+rather+a+way+to+be+in+community+with+others+while+still+getting+work+done.&location=DataLab%20Classroom%20–%20Shields%20360,%20Shields%20Library,%203rd%20floor,%20100%20NW%20Quad,%20Davis,%20CA,%2095616,%20United%20States&trp=false&ctz=America/Los_Angeles&sprop=website:https://datalab.ucdavis.edu>+ Add to iCalendar <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/datalab-co-working/?ical=1>

Sincerely,
Your CooRdinators
